# Reader fixtures

Four synthetic messages for `tests/render_comfort.rs`, reader timing and
snapshot QA (`seed -- <new.sqlite3> 0 tests/fixtures/reader`;
`KOMOREBI_SNAPSHOT_SELECT=n` opens file n+1). **None of it is real mail**:
addresses use `example.*` and `komorebi.invalid` domains, remote images
point at `example.com` hosts (blocked, and refused offline), and every
name, number and story is made up. The three heavy ones were generated by a
shell loop, so their content is repetitive on purpose.

| File | What it models | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `01-emoji` | a shipping notice with emoji at 48, 22, 15 and 13 px, in body text and in a button, plus flags, a family ZWJ sequence and text symbols | colour emoji (fallback to Segoe UI Emoji, more than one hue painted) |
| `02-heavy-newsletter` | 60 two-column stories in a 640 px table, 60 media queries, 60 remote photos, a tracking pixel (75 KB) | open-time corpus |
| `03-heavy-digest` | a 120-message mailing-list digest: a linked contents list, 480 paragraphs, quotes and `#fragment` anchors (206 KB) | open-time corpus, dark dimming (light page with grey text) |
| `04-heavy-statement` | a 1,200-row bank statement table with `bgcolor` zebra rows, `<font color>` amounts and `nowrap` cells (311 KB) | open-time corpus |

The open-time corpus is these four plus the 14 in `tests/fixtures/html`
(18 messages; see CHANGELOG.md).

Keep CRLF line endings when editing them (`.gitattributes`).
